setlist.title: Shotgun center - This should be kept in the center of the mix. Used with Figure-8 for mid/side mix
Figure-8 L/R stereo track - This must be kept at hard left and hard right. Bringing them towards the center will cause cancellation. Used with shotgun center for mid/side mix
Cardioid left - can be anywhere in the left side of the mix, probably between shotguns and omnis
Cardioid right - can be anywhere in the right side of the mix, probably between shotguns and omnis
Shotgun left - can be anywhere in the left side, probably inside the cardioids
Shotgun right - can be anywhere in the right side, probably inside the cardioids
Omni left - can be anywhere in the left side, probably between the figure-8 and cardioids
Omni right - can be anywhere in the right side, probably between the figure-8 and cardioids
